## A. Stationarity of the Cement series

This section explores transformations and differencing for the Cement production series.

```r
# Australia Cement production
aus_production |>
  autoplot(Cement) +
  labs(title = "Cement production in Australia")
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Plots the raw Cement production series from aus_production.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- The series shows trending behavior and seasonal patterns.
- Variance appears to increase over time.
:::

```r
# Stabilise variance
aus_production |>
  autoplot(
    log(Cement)
    ) +
  labs(title = "Cement production in Australia")
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Applies a log transformation to stabilize variance.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- The log transformation reduces the increasing variance.
:::

```r
# Account for seasonality
aus_production |>
  autoplot(
    log(Cement) |> difference(lag=12)
    ) +
  labs(title = "Cement production in Australia")
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Applies seasonal differencing (lag=12) to the log-transformed series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Seasonal differencing removes the seasonal component.
- The series may still show trends.
:::

```r
# Let's get some help from gg_tsdisplay
aus_production |>
  gg_tsdisplay(
    log(Cement) |> difference(lag=12)
  )
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Uses gg_tsdisplay to examine ACF and PACF of the seasonally differenced series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- The ACF suggests further differencing may be needed.
:::

```r
aus_production |>
  autoplot(
    log(Cement) |> difference(12) |> difference(1)
    ) +
  labs(title = "Cement production in Australia")
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Applies both seasonal and first differencing to the log series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- The doubly differenced series appears stationary.
:::

```r
aus_production |>
  gg_tsdisplay(
    log(Cement) |> difference(12) |> difference(1)
  )
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Displays ACF and PACF of the doubly differenced series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- The ACF decays quickly, indicating stationarity.
- The series is not white noise.
:::

```r
# Let's verify through more official 
aus_production |>
  features(log(Cement), feat_stl)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Computes STL decomposition features for the log series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Checks seasonal strength and other features.
:::

```r
aus_production |>
  features(log(Cement), 
           unitroot_nsdiffs)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Determines the number of seasonal differences needed.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Based on seasonal strength.
:::

```r
aus_production |>
  features(log(Cement) |> difference(12), 
           unitroot_ndiffs)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Determines the number of first differences needed after seasonal differencing.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Uses KPSS test for non-seasonal differences.
:::

## B. Stationarity of PBS series (A10 and H02)

This section examines the A10 and H02 series from PBS data.

```r
a10 <- PBS |>
  filter(ATC2 == "A10") |>
  summarise(Cost = sum(Cost))

a10 |> autoplot(Cost)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Creates the A10 series by filtering and summarizing PBS data.
- Plots the A10 cost series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Features of the series in terms of stationarity.
:::

```r
# Difference without transformation - what do you see?
a10 |> autoplot(
  difference(Cost,12)
  )
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Applies seasonal differencing to A10 without transformation.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Effect of differencing on the series.
:::

```r
a10 |> autoplot(
  difference(log(Cost),12)
  )
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Applies seasonal differencing to the log-transformed A10 series.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Comparison with previous plot.
:::

```r
a10 |> 
  features(
    difference(log(Cost),12), 
    unitroot_ndiffs)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Checks if further differencing is needed for the log-differenced A10.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Number of additional differences required.
:::

```r
## h02
h02 <- PBS |>
  filter(ATC2 == "H02") |>
  summarise(Cost = sum(Cost))
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

- Creates the H02 series similarly to A10.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Initial features of the H02 series.
:::


::: {.callout-note}
## What this code is doing

::: {.callout-note}
